definition: Each value is the total minimum gold needed to field one normal tower directly at the shown level. Values are cumulative totals, not per-upgrade increments, and must not be summed across earlier levels.

verifiedThrough.note: The official announcement history through this date contains no later Dual, Trio, or Quad normal-tower cost change. The 2024-06-28 total-cost change applies only to Level 4 Single Element and Periodic towers.

sources.label: Official developer-linked Element TD 2 DPS/Gold Values spreadsheet
sources.supports: Tower rows label the field as Gold Cost and show total level costs, including Dual 500/1300/3300 and Trio 1500/5000.

sources.label: Official Version 1.3 announcement
sources.supports: Dual Element Tower cost changed to 500/1300/3300.

sources.label: Official Version 1.6 announcement
sources.supports: Quad Element Tower total cost increased from 4000 to 4250.

sources.label: Official Version 1.9.4 announcement
